definitions.explanation: An astronomical phenomenon where the Moon passes between the Sun and Earth, partially or fully blocking the Sun's light.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧、{日食|にっしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧。
examples.english: A solar eclipse will occur tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皆既日食|かいきにっしょく}→皆既日食：29532_kaikinisshoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ために→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I traveled to see a total solar eclipse.

examples.japanese: {日食|にっしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{見|み}ると→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|いた}める→傷める：02098_itameru⟧。
examples.english: Looking directly at a solar eclipse can damage your eyes.

notes:
{日食|にっしょく} refers to a solar eclipse.

TYPES OF SOLAR ECLIPSES:
- ⟦{皆既日食|かいきにっしょく}→皆既日食：29532_kaikinisshoku⟧ (total solar eclipse)
- ⟦{部分日食|ぶぶんにっしょく}→部分日食：29533_bubunnisshoku⟧ (partial solar eclipse)
- ⟦{金環日食|きんかんにっしょく}→金環日食：29534_kinkannisshoku⟧ (annular solar eclipse)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {日食|にっしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧ (a solar eclipse occurs)
- {日食|にっしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (observe a solar eclipse)
- {日食|にっしょく}⟦メガネ→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧ (eclipse glasses)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{月食|げっしょく}→月食：06312_gesshoku⟧: lunar eclipse
- ⟦{蝕|しょく}→蝕：noentry⟧: eclipse (general term)
